description: Exceptional apartment with a private terrace in the heart of the Champs-Élysées. Spacious, bright and fully air-conditioned, it can accommodate up to 10 people, with 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a large living room and a fitted kitchen. Enjoy an elegant, tranquil and unique setting in Paris, ideal for a stay with family or friends.The spaceLocated in the heart of the 8th arrondissement, in the prestigious Champs-Élysées area, this exceptional apartment offers an outstanding setting for a stay in Paris.From the moment you arrive, you will enjoy a large, bright living area comprising a living room, dining room and fully equipped open-plan kitchen, all of which lead onto a superb furnished private terrace, ideal for meals or relaxing.🛏️ Sleeping arrangements:4 comfortable bedrooms with high-end beddingCapacity for up to 10 people🚿 Bathrooms:2 modern bathrooms (shower/bath)1 extra toilet🌿 Pros:Exceptional, peaceful, private terraceAir conditioning throughout the apartmentVery fast Wi-Fi, TV (Netflix, etc.)Fully-equipped kitchenSpacious and stylish apartmentA true haven of peace right in the heart of Paris, a stone's throw from the Champs-Élysées, perfect for enjoying the city while benefiting from a quiet location.Baby cot available in the apartment and free of charge.Guest accessMetro 1 metro 9 or RER A.
